ui.title: Custom fields · smoke · Page entry and navigation
ui.preconditions: Owner session; seeded test workspace; page API /api/v1/workspace/custom_fields; backing data workspace_resources.

Open the page from its navigation item; check the H1, selected navigation entry, workspace selector, and primary content.
Check the Title column and confirm no private data is exposed to the wrong account.

bdd.scenario: Custom fields: an owner opens the page
bdd.given: Given the Nexora owner is authenticated or is creating a workspace
bdd.when: When an owner opens the page
bdd.then: Then the page heading and primary content are visible
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with the screen API /api/v1/workspace/custom_fields and the data tables workspace_resources
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Custom fields: the owner searches for a known record
bdd.given: Given the Nexora owner is authenticated or is creating a workspace
bdd.when: When the owner searches for a known record
bdd.then: Then the matching record is shown and unrelated records are hidden
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with the screen API /api/v1/workspace/custom_fields and the data tables workspace_resources
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Custom fields: the owner submits valid required fields
bdd.given: Given the Nexora owner is authenticated or is creating a workspace
bdd.when: When the owner submits valid required fields
bdd.then: Then the record is saved and displayed in the active workspace
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with the screen API /api/v1/workspace/custom_fields and the data tables workspace_resources
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Custom fields: the owner omits a required field
bdd.given: Given the Nexora owner is authenticated or is creating a workspace
bdd.when: When the owner omits a required field
bdd.then: Then field validation appears and the record is not saved
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with the screen API /api/v1/workspace/custom_fields and the data tables workspace_resources
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.
